why_it_fails: resolution/website discovery: fallback search returned NO_LEAD. Stored evidence shows html.duckduckgo.com answers HTTP 202 with a bot challenge and www.bing.com/search answers 200 with unrelated Microsoft pages for the quoted-address query, so no candidate website is ever found even though the brand site exists. Static HTML has only the loader token, no numeric store id, so adapters._detect_endpoint cannot name the Jane store without observing the render's network calls.
fix_idea: Replace the fallback search with a working source (e.g. the OpenRouter web plugin the verifier already uses, or a brand-level locator) and treat a results page where nothing names the store as a search failure, not 'no lead'. Resolve Jane loader embeds by observing api.iheartjane.com/v1/stores/<id> during render. Rec store id = 4056.
